module: Demolition-type scenario extension: it declares as winner the last vehicle still moving. Every second, it compares each scenario vehicle's position to its last known position; a vehicle that moves 1 m or less for more than 15 seconds is considered stopped.
notes: Only one vehicle must be moving and all the others must have exceeded 15 stopped ticks for scenario_scenarios.finish to be called with the message '<name> WINS!!!' (hard-coded text, not translated).
The movement test is done about once per second (dt accumulation in onPreRender), threshold distance 1 m.
The extension does nothing if the scenario is not in the 'running' state. The vehicle list is rebuilt on every onScenarioChange when scenario.state == 'running'.

onScenarioChange.desc: Hook called by scenario_scenarios on every scenario state change. When the scenario goes to 'running', resets the tracking and registers each scenario.vehicles vehicle found in the scenetree. Without a scenario, resets everything to zero.

sc.desc: Argument passed by the hook, unused (the scenario is re-read via scenario_scenarios.getScenario()).

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering each frame. Every second, detects stationary vehicles and ends the scenario if only one vehicle is left moving.
